info.name: EventHubAPI - Functional
info.description:
## Overview

This collection contains functional tests for the **EventHub API** — a platform for managing events and bookings. It validates the full API surface across authentication, event management, and booking workflows, covering both happy-path (CRUD) and negative/edge-case scenarios.

---

### Notes:

- A total of **6 failed test assertions** have been identified to date.
    
- The identified failures are attributed to **BUG-001 and BUG-005**, as documented in the **Bug Reports** collection.
    
- The response time test assertion may fail when the response time exceeds **2,000 ms**.
    

---

## Authentication

All requests are secured using a **Bearer token** (`{{authToken}}`), configured at the collection level. A dedicated **Admin Login** folder handles admin-level authentication flows.

## Collection-Level Test Scripts

Every request in this collection automatically runs the following assertions:

- Response `Content-Type` is `application/json`
    
- Response body is not null or empty
    
- Response time is within **2000ms**
    

---

## Folder Structure

### Health

Verifies that the API is up and reachable via a health check endpoint.

### Config

Retrieves public feature flags and configuration settings exposed by the API.

### Authorization

Covers user authentication flows, split into:

- **CRUD** — Register a new user, log in, and retrieve the currently authenticated user.
    
- **Negative Tests** — Validates proper error handling for missing credentials, invalid email/password, empty payloads, expired tokens, and unauthorized access.
    

### Events

Manages the full lifecycle of events, organized into:

- **CRUD** — Create, read, update, and delete events.
    
- **Search Events** — Tests event search and filtering functionality.
    
- **Negative Tests** — Covers invalid inputs and unauthorized operations for create, get, update, and delete actions.
    

### Bookings

Handles ticket booking operations, organized into:

- **CRUD** — Create, retrieve, look up, list, and cancel bookings.
    
- **Negative Tests** — Validates error responses for invalid booking requests across list, lookup, get, create, and cancel operations.

item.description:
## Admin Login

This folder covers the **admin authentication flow** for the EventHub API. It contains the two core requests needed to establish and verify an authenticated session:

| Request | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Login with existing credentials | `POST` | `/auth/login` |
| Get the currently authenticated user | `GET` | `/auth/me` |

### Purpose

- Authenticate an admin user using existing credentials and obtain a bearer token via `POST /auth/login`.
- Confirm the session is valid by retrieving the currently authenticated user's profile via `GET /auth/me`.

> The bearer token returned from login is expected to be stored in an environment variable (e.g. `{{authToken}}`) and used by downstream requests that require authorization.

item.description:
## Authorization - CRUD

This folder covers the core **happy-path authentication flows** for the EventHub API. It groups the three foundational auth endpoints that must succeed before any protected resource can be accessed:

| Request | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Register a new user | `POST` | `/auth/register` |
| Login with registered new user | `POST` | `/auth/login` |
| Get the currently authenticated user | `GET` | `/auth/me` |

### Purpose

- Validate that a new user can be **registered** successfully and receives a valid response.
    
- Confirm that a registered user can **log in** and obtain a bearer token, which is stored in the `testAuthToken` environment variable for use by downstream requests.
    
- Verify that the **authenticated user profile** (`/auth/me`) is returned correctly when a valid token is present.
    

> **Note:** Negative and edge-case scenarios (e.g. missing credentials, expired tokens, invalid email) are covered in the sibling folder **Authorization - Negative Tests**.

item.description:
## Authorization

This folder contains all authentication-related test scenarios for the EventHub API. It is organized into two sub-folders that together cover the full spectrum of authorization testing — from successful flows to failure conditions.

| Sub-folder | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| **Authorization - CRUD** | Happy-path flows: user registration, login, and fetching the authenticated user profile |
| **Authorization - Negative Tests** | Edge cases and failure scenarios: missing credentials, invalid email/password, expired token, empty payload, and unauthorized access |

### Coverage

- **Happy Path** — Validates that a user can register, log in, and retrieve their profile using a valid bearer token.
    
- **Negative / Edge Cases** — Verifies that the API returns appropriate error responses when requests are malformed, credentials are invalid, or authentication tokens are missing or expired.
    

> Bearer token authentication is inherited from the parent collection and the `{{testAuthToken}}` environment variable is used across protected endpoints.

This folder contains all API requests related to event management within the EventHub system. These requests validate the core CRUD operations of the Events resource, ensuring that event data is correctly handled, persisted, and returned by the API. Tests in this folder verify both successful workflows and edge cases such as invalid inputs, unauthorized access, and non-existent resources.
